read.en: Lumentum fell 8.5% on Nov 16 to $546.00, trading $539.21–562.25. It is below the 5-day ($600.2), 10-day ($595.2), 30-day ($799.4), 100-day ($838.5) and 200-day ($814.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram widening slightly again; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($747.58), and RSI is 34.5.
read.zh: Lumentum 11月16日下跌 8.5%，收于 $546.00，盘中区间 $539.21–562.25。股价位于 5 日（$600.2）、10 日（$595.2）、30 日（$799.4）、100 日（$838.5）和 200 日均线（$814.7）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图再度小幅放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$747.58），RSI 为 34.5。

read.en: The drop broke the $569–591 supports (Nov 13, 10 and 12 lows), now resistance; the $539.21 low dipped under the Nov 9 low ($545.01) before the close recovered to it. Resistance is $562.3–570.4, then $585.6–600.2 (Nov 10 close, 10 and 5-day) and $624–626.8. Support is $538.6–545, then $518 (Nov 6 low) and $506.7–509.7 (Nov 5). A close above $570.4 would target $586–600; below $538.6, $518.
